Q: Can install docker with yum on centos 7 A:

This is an issue with download.docker.com that they have had open since September.

Basically they decided to retire the 7Server urls. They redirect to the plain 7 for the url https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/7Server, but not for any older urls.

The workaround is to call this:

sudo yum-config-manager --setopt="docker-ce-stable.baseurl=https://download.docker.com/linux/centos/7/x86_64/stable" --save

Before you call the sudo yum install command.

Q: Sort and Remove unused usings in C# code A:

Remove unnecessary usings:

Place your cursor anywhere within the using statements at the top of the file, then press Ctrl + . (Windows) or Cmd + . (Mac) to open the Quick Fix menu. Select "Remove unnecessary usings" from the options that appear.

Sort:

I personally recommend using an auto-formatter that will sort automatically on each save. Csharpier does this out of the box.
